## About
Euro Star is a car repair and maintenance shop on Maple Ave in Pennsauken. We work on Mercedes-Benz and on all makes of vehicles, foreign and domestic, from oil changes and brake jobs to engine work.
Our goal is simple: give you the information you need to make the correct decision about your car. One longtime customer wrote that owner Meni took her into the shop to show her the old broken parts and answer all of her questions.
We're open Monday through Friday, and we hold a 4.3 rating from 52 Google reviews. If you need a ride to home or work while your car is here, ask about our shuttle.

## Services
- Routine maintenance: Oil changes, computer diagnostics, system cleaning, and even simple things like correcting your tire pressure.
- Brake systems: Everything from full brake systems to replacing pads.
- Engine maintenance and repairs: Engine maintenance and repairs, plus alternators and electrical work.
- Transmissions and mufflers: Transmissions, mufflers and exhaust systems.
- Wheel alignment: Adjusting wheel alignment for correct steering and suspension.
- Air conditioning: From entire coolant systems to recharging refrigerants.
- Pre-purchase inspections: Have us look over a car before you buy it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on Mercedes-Benz?
A: No. We service Mercedes-Benz and all makes of vehicles, foreign and domestic.

Q: Can I get a ride while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes. We offer shuttle service if you need a ride to home or work.

Q: Do you have any specials?
A: Call our service department and mention our website to hear about current specials.
